audit.whatIsWrong: diff EVEN / diffRating 6/10 while Swain wins 54.86% over 463 games, and the mirror (karma__swain) already resolved this as FAVOURED / 4/10.
audit.why: Both directions must agree; the mirror set Swain FAVOURED at 4/10 difficulty with carry threat 6/10.
audit.corrected: diff FAVOURED, diffRating 4/10, carryRating unchanged at 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart on disk reads Skill/Swain/Swain/Skill/Skill/Swain/Swain in both layers, contradicting its own whys[] (which describe Karma winning levels 1-5 and the first item) and contradicting the mirror.
audit.why: The whys already say Karma out-ranges Swain until his ultimate and that her first item extends the poke; the mirror locked the chart to Karma/Karma/Karma/Karma/Skill/Karma/Skill.
audit.corrected: Chart proposed as matched full+content pairs: Karma, Karma, Karma, Karma, Skill, Karma, Skill; ratings dropped to 4/10 on the rows Karma owns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states that Nevermove roots only on the return sweep, never gives Focused Resolve's 675 range / 12s flat cooldown as the way to break the tether, and never mentions that Demonic Ascension ends when no champion is being drained.
audit.why: Riot text: Swain E 'launches a wave forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits' (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s). Karma W is a 675-range tether, flat 12s, that only roots if unbroken, and Mantra-W heals her. Swain R is 120s and 'indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions'.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, tradeGood, wants.you[0] and wants.foe[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] said 'Wrap Focused Resolve' — flagged as a near-miss ability name and a nonsense verb.
audit.why: The ability is Focused Resolve; the verb should be 'tether'.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with the correct verb and the 675 root range.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal note despite Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve healing Karma through extended trades.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule needs-antiheal for this exact pairing.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds requirement added to whys[4].

edits.before: W-poke and AA harass win the range war. Identify how Karma contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Her Q out-ranges everything you have and Mantra turns it into a root — take safe CS and note where she stands.

edits.before: E-root into the pull is your whole kill setup. Only take the trade when Karma's Focused Resolve is down.
edits.after: Focused Resolve is up and your E is not — she tethers any step-up. Trade only when her 12s root is spent.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Karma must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but her Q out-ranges your W — hold the wave near your side so she must step into Nevermove.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Focused Resolve's cooldown.
edits.after: Her poke and shield cycle outpace your first item — fight only in the 12s gap after Focused Resolve is spent.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Karma carry threat 6/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: your drain wins the side-lane 1v1, her poke wins the five-man fight. Force the 1v1, refuse the group.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve: matchup-defining — Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Focused Resolve: flat 12s, 675 range — it only roots if the tether holds, so break range or vision. - Nevermove: 12s, and it roots on the return sweep, not the way out. - Demonic Ascension: 120s, and it ends the moment no champion is being drained.

edits.before: Track Karma's Focused Resolve: Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. When it is down — E-root + W pull drain.
edits.after: Focused Resolve tethers at 675 and roots only if you stay in it — walk out to break it. Then E on its return sweep, pull, drain.

edits.before: Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Her tether breaks if you leave 675 range or line of sight. Engage once it is down — 12s flat.

edits.before: E-root Karma's step-up when his answer is down, right-click to drag the soul fragment, and Q the stacked wave-trade.
edits.after: E-root her step-up on Nevermove's return sweep when Focused Resolve is down, pull, then Q the stacked wave-trade.

edits.before: Demonic Ascension neutralises the Focused Resolve tether for the first time — she roots you inside drain range and heals you back the tether damage; neither side can force a clean kill.
edits.after: Demonic Ascension drains through the tether, but Mantra-W heals her while it holds — bring Grievous Wounds or her heal cancels your drain; neither side forces a clean kill at 6.

edits.before: Land E on Karma's Focused Resolve step-up so you can pull the Soul Fragment and punish her committed engage
edits.after: Land Nevermove's return sweep on her Focused Resolve step-up, pull her in, and punish the committed tether

edits.before: Wrap Focused Resolve on you when you step up, root you mid-poke, and kite back with Inspire move speed
edits.after: Tether Focused Resolve as you step up, hold 675 range for the root, then kite back with Inspire's move speed

notes: Chart flipped to match the packet and the karma__swain mirror; every row proposed as a matched full+content pair. phases[4] left as Skill (already correct). Ratings on Karma-owned rows dropped to 4/10 to stop the chart contradicting the new diffRating.
